Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the eastbound feeder road in Sugar Land, Texas, when the rear of the
vehicle was struck by Dirver 2's sedan at a low rate of speed. Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy involved. A
Psasenger seated in the front passenger position reported pain in the left wrist and was transported for evaluation.
Officers confirmed the Passenger was present in the vehicle at the time of impact, and statements from both drivers
agree on that point. No independent witnesses were located at the scene. Photographs taken by the responding
officer show rear bumper displacement and a cracked taillight lens, which are generally consistent with the reported
impact. The damage pattern appears largely in line with the force described by both drivers. A few faint scratches on
the rear quarter panel may predate this collision, and the reporting officer noted them without attributing them to this
event. The reported wrist injury is consistent with the mechanism of a sudden rear impact of this kind. Both drivers
were cooperative, and no citations were issued at the scene.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.

- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
